top_signals.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion dollar backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
top_signals.summary: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nvidia, SpaceX, Microsoft launch AI safety initiative as OpenAI cyberattack fallout continues
top_signals.summary: Microsoft, SpaceX, Palantir, alongside dozens of other tech companies from the U.S. and Europe, have joined the Open Secure AI Alliance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Carlyle’s Bansal Says Bonds Shed Role as Stocks’ Shock Absorber
top_signals.summary: Carlyle Group Inc.’s asset-backed finance chief said traditional fixed income is losing its reliability as a portfolio shock absorber because those investments are becoming increasingly correlated with stocks.
